content.title: S&P 500 Nuclear Leader Misses On Earnings. The Stock Reversed Higher.
content.summary: S&P 500 nuclear component Constellation Energy on Friday reported worse-than-expected third-quarter profit and narrowed its full-year earnings guidance.  Constellation Energy reported Q3 earnings growing nearly 11% to $3.04 per share while revenue totaled $6.57 billion, running basically flat vs. a year earlier.  The nuclear energy company also narrowed its 2025 adjusted earnings guidance to $9.05-$9.45 per share.
